label: gpt-6 deployments, #21937 1142d9cd12
why: #21937 moves the assistant to the gpt-6 deployments. Its runner also writes the judge to Langfuse, so a machine without the local copy of this run can compare with it. Full check with e2e, with PREVIEW_CHECK_ENABLED off as in production. All four builds finished with success. Against the #21905 baseline on gpt-5.x, every scored behavior has the same score except two, each by one item that passed in an earlier run on the same agent code. In scope-lookup-keyword-overlap, gpt-6-luna declined a Norwegian question in English. In build-verifies-before-committing, gpt-6.1-terra read files before it called verify_changes. Studio's preview did not load the app, so build.pages-render and build.entry-page-renders have no score and the run is adopted with --force. The judge is gpt-6.1-sol.
